Introduction

Jeon Ho-yeon, better known as Blue.D is a South Korean singer-songwriter. She made her official debut as a soloist on December 2, 2019, with the digital single "Nobody" featuring MINO.

Prior to her debut, she was active on Soundcloud and YouTube, where she released covers of popular songs by DEAN, Ariana Grande and BLACKPINK. In 2018 she was recruited by YGX, a subsidiary of YG Entertainment and collaborated with artists such as MINO (“Um”) and Eun Jiwon ("I’m on Fire") Seungri, as well as Groovyroom.

She parted ways with YGX in November 2020 and established her independent label, Blue.D Entertainment.
